title: Canonical derived base change for an invertible module on a flat family
statement: Choose shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category] for all schemes. Let f:X\to S be quasi-compact, separated and flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], let (g\prime,f\prime,f,g) be a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product], and M an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then the canonical derived base-change morphism [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] Lg^*Rf_*(M[0])\to Rf\prime_*Lg\prime^*(M[0]) is invertible. No vanishing of higher direct images is assumed.

proof.text: Use the existing isFlatOver_of_isInvertible for f to give relative flatness of M, and quasi-coherence from invertibility. Tensor pullback is additive since its tensor-pullback adjunction makes it a left adjoint and right exact. Apply the canonical relatively flat module comparison to obtain c, its characterizing predicate, and invertibility of baseChange ≫ Rf′_*(c).

Apply isFlatOver_of_isInvertible to the identity of X. The canonical derived pullback comparison at this intrinsically flat module is invertible. Derived direct image preserves invertibility. Cancel Rf′_*(c) using isIso_comp_right_iff to obtain the displayed canonical base-change invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedBaseChange_of_flat_invertible
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Flat f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (M : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} M] :
    IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M))
